edits.after: Flinching off a raised Q feeds his counter-knockup — hold until the cast animation lands, not the wind-up, or you engage into his answer instead of past it.
Time anti-heal to his passive
Triumphant Roar heals him off any nearby champion damage once charged, so have anti-heal ready before a long trade, not after he's already topped off.
Ignore his stacked Trample
Trample's stun is an auto-attack reset off stacks, not a cast — the wind-up on his next auto is your cue to back off before the stun lands, not after.
